title: Represent a Mapping Sample
story: The observatory plots fictional measurements on a toy chamber.
lesson: Keep geometry and scalar metadata together in a record. Dictionaries give each field an explicit meaning.
objective: Return {'position': point, 'voltage': voltage, 'time_ms': time_ms}. point contains three coordinates in toy units.
sample: point=[1,0,0], voltage=2, time=5 -> labeled sample record
hint: Copy the point into the position field and label the two scalars.
